mined: Row-invariant group formulation y = sum_g s*P + b*xs with P from MPP matmul2d over one weight group, fp32 group sums, K slices fixed by weight shape and reduced in slice order.
The 16-row fragment mapping (fm/fn lanes), interleaved (s, b) pair loads, and the 32-row block tiling (TMR).
modifications: Generalized from affine q4/group-64 to affine 2/3/4/5/6/8-bit at group sizes 32/64/128, and to unquantized bf16/fp16 weights (plain accumulation, no scale/bias).

8-bit and 16-bit weights feed MPP natively (uint8_t, bfloat/half); 2/3/5/6-bit weights are decoded per group from MLX's LSB-first bitstream into threadgroup uint8 with a generated, fully unrolled decode (original).
Per column tile weight views start at a 64-bit row offset so weights over 2 GB (a bf16 vocabulary head) index correctly (original fix).
Unpack staging shares threadgroup memory with the slice-reduction buffer; split-K caps the staging at 16 KB.
Keeps MLX's weight layout (no tiled regrouping); scale/bias pairs keep the scales' own dtype (bf16 or fp16) instead of casting to bf16.

Installation swaps nn.QuantizedLinear/nn.Linear instances to subclasses per module (no global monkeypatch), reports covered/refused formats, and falls back to stock for longer calls, unsupported formats and non-M5 devices; process-wide set_enabled switch for paired A/B only.
Group sums of x are computed inside the matmul kernel (four lanes per row, fixed (q0+q1)+(q2+q3) order) instead of a separate launch (original).
Same-format sibling projections that read one input (q/k/v, gate/up, GDN in_proj_*, generic names or adapter-declared) are stacked into one launch via zero-copy row views (original).
Row window: min_rows (default 4, stock below; 1 = exact) and max_rows (stock above); the law id reports the window and grouping.

Specialize the mined TMR structure as one 16-row fragment per threadgroup instead of two. Interleaved M5 q4/group-64 A/B tests through the 128-row packed prefill chunk preserved the one-row law; the stable 32/64/128-row cells reduced median projection time while the noisy 16-row cell was neutral end to end at B1. Evidence is under qualification/runs/dflash-packed-target-correction-20261005/.
validation: CPU: tests/test_lane_matmul.py (36 tests): generated decode vs MLX dequantization for 2/3/5/6-bit x group 32/64/128, geometry, preparation, install/uninstall fallback, and grouping (column slicing, one launch per input, view-backed weights with unchanged stock output). M5 Max GPU: scripts/lane_matmul_gate.py 76/76 small cases (all widths x group sizes x bf16/fp16) and 28/28 model shapes incl. a 5120x248320 bf16 head; every row of 1..128-row calls bitwise equal to the row alone; error vs fp32 reference <= MLX's own. In-model A/B inside mlx2's Qwen3.8 (oQ4e, uniform 4-bit) and Muse-Glimmer models: 8-16 row forwards 29-49% cheaper than stock; one-row +28% (hence the default min_rows=4 crossover).
